title: Ode To The Mets
lyrics:
[00:48.10]Up on his horse, up on his horse
[00:53.42]Not gonna wake up here anymore
[00:58.60]Listen one time, it's not the truth
[01:03.82]It's just a story I tell to you
[01:09.03]Easy to say, easy to do
[01:14.26]But it's not easy, well, maybe for you
[01:19.47]Hope that you find it, hope that it's good
[01:24.70]Hope that you read it, think that you should
[01:29.89]Cuts you some slack as he sits back
[01:35.07]Sizes you up, plans his attack
[01:41.62]Drums please, Fab
[01:45.55]And I got it all, I got it all
[01:50.76]Waiting for me down on the street
[01:55.55]But now you gotta do something special for me
[02:01.20]I'm gonna say what's on my mind
[02:06.42]Then I'll walk out, then I'll feel fine
[02:10.81]Yeah, I'm under his thumb, I'm on his back
[02:16.21]I will not show my teeth too quick
[02:21.54]I needed you there, I needed you there
[02:27.19]But I didn't know, I didn't know
[02:33.77]Go alone
[02:38.37]I'll go alone
[02:43.58]We'll go alone
[02:48.82]I'll go alone
[03:03.84]Back from his trip, he's at the door
[03:08.99]When he gets back, he's on the phone
[03:14.28]Innocent eye, innocent heart
[03:19.38]No, it's not wrong, but it's not right
[03:24.66]Innocent times, out on his own
[03:29.87]Not gonna do that, come out of control
[03:35.08]I was just bored, playing the guitar
[03:40.35]Learned all your tricks, wasn't too hard
[03:44.89]It's the last one now, I can promise you that
[03:49.77]I'm gonna find out the truth when I get back
[04:18.15]Gone now are the old times
[04:23.08]Forgotten, time to hold on the railing
[04:31.15]The Rubik's Cube isn't solving for us
[04:38.97]Old friends long forgotten
[04:43.89]The old ways at the bottom of the ocean
[04:52.02]Now has swallowed the only thing that's left
[05:01.23]Is us, so pardon the silence that you're hearing
[05:09.96]It's turning into a deafening, painful, shameful roar
